name: jobspresso-mcp
description: Jobspresso (jobs): search. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search
tools.description: WP Job Manager job feed (?feed=job_feed, RSS 2.0). WP Job Manager's job_feed() reads search_keywords, search_location (';'-separated), job_types, job_categories and posts_per_page (default 10) and pages with paged (https://github.com/Automattic/WP-Job-Manager/blob/trunk/includes/class-wp-job-manager-post-types.php). company / location come from the job_listing:company / job_listing:location elements, description is the full post (content:encoded, HTML); job_type and job_category stay in raw. id is the posting's permalink. Jobspresso's /feed/ is an empty blog feed; ?feed=job_feed carries the remote jobs.
